decisions.reason: The SPS30 and ZE08-CH2O remain 5V loads, and the source does not change any sensor-board connector or pinout.
The standalone supply already powers the full shared 3.3V rail; moving the LEDs onto that rail does not change the stated regulator, activation, or source-selection requirements.
The source changes LED supply and data logic, not the indicator board's LED count, selected part, package, or color format.
The AXP2101 battery, USB, VMID/VSYS, and DCDC1 source topology remains valid unchanged.
The impact is already fully represented by the existing same-message MODIFY adding addressable LEDs to 3.3V measurement coverage; 5V monitoring remains required for the sensors.
Changing the LED supply voltage does not revoke or alter the independently stated behavior of cutting LED power when unused or controlling LED power separately from sensor power.
The interboard interface already carries both 3.3V and 5V, and the source does not change connector types, pinouts, or board topology.
The existing same-message MODIFY already records the 3.3V supply, direct ESP32 drive, removal of the obsolete level-shifter part, and accepted indicator-brightness condition.
The source adds LEDs as a 3.3V load but does not change the configured DCDC1 voltage, target rail voltage, compensation method, or regulation condition.
LED supply and logic changes do not affect the panel power-button connector, PWRON connection, or control behavior.
The source concerns only the LEDs and does not change the SPS30 SEL-to-GND I2C mode selection.
The LED supply change has no effect on the battery connector's series, pin count, pin functions, mounting type, or unresolved pinout issue.
